full_text:
Article 4 (Methods of Selection Examination for Prosecution Investigators)
(1) Selection examinations for prosecution investigators shall be based on combined scores from interviews, service performance evaluations, and experience evaluations: Provided, That where the Chief of Staff of an armed service considers it necessary to assess knowledge required to perform the duties, a written examination on all or some of the subjects specified in the subparagraphs of Article 3 (2) may be administered in lieu of an interview.
(2) Article 3 (3) shall apply mutatis mutandis to interviews for prosecution investigators.
